# Welcome to <span class="name-highlight">WFRC Analytics</span> documentation.

The Wasatch Front Regional Council's Analytics portal serves as the central hub for technical documentation, validation reports, and resources supporting regional transportation planning. Explore our Travel Demand Model, Real-Estate Market Model, and Bike Demand Model, along with the analytical tools and methodologies that inform data-driven planning decisions across the Wasatch Front region.
